evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued in the present, commanding erasure of a category of knowledge — irrealis in demanding a state change that is not yet actual, abstract in targeting a class of contracts rather than a specific event.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative seeking a non-actual state change (knowledge removal not yet done), construing at the level of a category — 'all knowledge' and 'zeppelin routes' as a class rather than a particular route.
